_comment: Totem Grab (Redemption #5). Every number and every string the bot posts lives here.
real_totems: how many real totems spawn across duration_hours.
fake_totems: extra fake events on top of the real ones. Same warning, then one of fake_appear_messages.
Replying to a fake with anything that reads like a claim wipes that player's score to 0.
appear_delay_seconds: gap between the warning and the totem appearing, picked at random.
min_gap_minutes: minimum time between two warnings, so events never overlap.
